intended_object: A wrapper structure around an arbitrary function `HomStage G F U → HomStage G F V`, i.e. between the sets Hom(G/U, F) and Hom(G/V, F). It exists so that the transition maps of the directed system have a `FunLike` type, which `DirectLimit` in `Mathlib.Algebra.Colimit.DirectLimit` requires. This is inferred from the code and from how the file uses it.
explanation: The structure has a single field: an unrestricted function between two stage-hom types, with no homomorphism or compatibility conditions. Right after it, the file gives it a `FunLike` instance. It is then used only as the codomain of `homStageMap`, the transition maps that `DirectedSystem` and `DirectLimit` need, since these expect a `FunLike` family of maps. The name "HomStageHom" has no meaning in the literature; it is just a plumbing type for building the filtered colimit colim_U Hom(G/U, F). So it is a technical device with no mathematical counterpart of its own.
